liam: Quick callout from oncall: we've seen a pattern where a short p95 spike immediately flips canaries -> full rollback. Proposing 'latency-smoother' + confirm-sampling to reduce churn. Thoughts?
sara: +1. Define latency-smoother?
liam: Two pieces: 1) short exponential smoothing of p95 per-tenant (alpha ~0.25) to avoid reacting to single-sample blips, 2) a confirm-sampling phase where observer emits a candidate and router samples a bounded number of tenant-aware probes before any traffic change.
mike: How do we avoid extra load from probes? We should make them token-aware and budgeted per-tenant (max probes per minute). For tiny tenants, extend smoothing window instead of probing.
liam: Exactly. Proposal: observer computes candidate_score using smoothed p95 and recent error_rate; candidate only posted if score > S for T_smooth seconds. Router then runs up to 2 probes within a confirm_window. If probes pass, orchestrator proceeds with staged diversion.
sara: Also add a token-aware hysteresis: once a tenant is escalated, add suppression with decay rather than hard TTL so repeated weak signals decay rather than immediate re-escalation. That makes reentry cost proportional to severity.
qa-bot: Suggested telemetry fields: escalation.stage, smoothed_p95_ms, candidate_score, probe_attempts, suppression_decay_remaining. Include them in traces.
mike: Fallback flavors: prefer 'narrow-degrade' (quantized / reduced-context model) where quality loss is small, otherwise fallback to last-stable variant. Route owners should set fallback_preference in route config.
liam: Minimal config sketch (one-line for RFC): `auto_fallback:{enabled:true,score_threshold:2.0,smooth_s:45,confirm_probes:2,confirm_window_s:15,probe_budget_per_min:5,suppression_decay_mins:20,fallback_prefer_narrow:true}`
sara: Need runbook: candidate->probe->staged-split(10,40,100) with health-checks between steps and a manual breakglass. Also RBAC audit for automated actions.
liam: I'll author RFC with scoring formula, probe contract, smoothing math, suppression decay algorithm, and runbook. Small rolling test tenant tomorrow to validate. devops-bot: scheduled probe-path test at 1768950000.
